card.name: Contraception advice for males and females
card.fires_on: Words in the advice line telling males or females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception, mostly the word "use" after "partners of reproductive potential to", also "of" or "females" just before "reproductive potential".

modes.label: "use" before contraception
modes.description: The verb "use" right after "to" in advice to males with female partners of reproductive potential.
modes.example: Advise males with female partners of reproductive potential to<< use>> effective contraception during treatment with IWILFIN

modes.label: Before "reproductive potential"
modes.description: "of" or "females" in the phrase that leads into "reproductive potential".
modes.example: Advise females and males<< of>> reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment

card.writes: It pushes toward words about sperm, semen and fertility, and away from the word children.
card.plain: It fires in label advice about contraception for patients who could conceive or father a child, just before words on fertility and sperm.
